sections.text: Microsoft suffered a global outage affecting Outlook, Teams, and Office 365 services for around 24 hours. gist: A destructive puppy named Mr Baxter chewed many household items.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: A family adopted a malnourished cocker spaniel puppy in 2022 and renamed him Mr Baxter. The young dog immediately began chewing numerous personal belongings, ranging from clothing to books. Despite professional advice and carrot treats, the destructive chewing continued until steady training eventually paid off.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: The story highlights the challenges of owning a rescue dog with a difficult start in life. It shows how patience and routine can transform an unruly pet into a loyal and beloved companion.

sections.heading: What happens next
sections.text: The dog sadly died at four years old, leaving the owners with cherished memories and physical reminders of his time with them.

President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping are set to meet in China.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: Senator Maria Cantwell sent a letter to Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick criticizing the Department of Commerce for failing to keep Nvidia AI chips away from China. Cantwell accused the agency of ignoring warnings, weakening safeguards, and allowing companies like Alibaba and ByteDance to access advanced American technology.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: Cantwell stated that these failures undermine America's national security and give away the country's technology advantage in artificial intelligence. The criticism also highlights potential conflicts of interest regarding financial holdings in Nvidia stock.

sections.heading: What happens next
sections.text: A meeting in China is scheduled between US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping. Meanwhile, the Commerce Department is reportedly expected to unveil a new initiative designating Nvidia and other tech firms as AI national champions.

gist: Bex Williams survived a 2017 house fire started by her boyfriend's brother.
Cameron Logan died in the attack, and his older brother Blair was jailed.
Bex is sharing her story nearly a decade later after changing her career.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: Bex Williams and Cameron Logan returned to a family home in Glasgow after a Hogmanay party. They fell asleep on an inflatable mattress in the living room. Cameron's older brother, Blair Logan, poured petrol over them and set fire to their bed. Cameron and the family dog died, while Bex suffered severe injuries.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: The attack highlights domestic trauma and its lifelong impact. Bex abandoned her radio broadcasting career due to vocal cord damage from the fire. She now works for Police Scotland to help others, honouring Cameron's ambition to join the force.

sections.heading: What happens next
sections.text: Bex tells her story fully for the first time in a television series. The first episode is scheduled to be shown on BBC Scotland on Tuesday 17 November and will then be available on BBC iPlayer.

sections.text: Boots announced it is starting to prescribe medical cannabis through its online SureLeaf service, a first for a UK high street pharmacy.
